note: Maps the suite's five IRT difficulty tiers onto the D-ladder. Unlike Coding this bench already HAS a spread — 46 items with every category carrying one item per IRT tier — so it can climb from existing content without generation. It is also the bench that proved the need for a ladder: task-bank defaultRun.rationale records that tiers 1-3 'are saturated for frontier models and contribute no discrimination', and the response was to hand-abandon them. A climb makes that automatic — a rig that walks D2/D3 and stops at D5 says the same thing without anyone editing a fixture set.
irtNote: tierDifficulty b-parameters are on a logit scale: -1.0, 0.0, 1.5, 2.5, 3.5. The mapping is order-preserving; it does NOT claim a b of 3.5 equals 18 hours of expert work. T_human comes from the D-tier anchor table, and those anchors are provisional.
